title: JRE 2373 - Dave Landau
guestBio: Dave Landau is a comedian, co-host of the "Normal World" podcast, and author of "Party of One: A Fuzzy Memoir." His latest special is "A Prison 10."
tldr: Dave Landau discusses his comedy special 'A Prison 10' and the creative process behind it
Conversation about Dave's memoir 'Party of One: A Fuzzy Memoir' and personal stories from his life
Dave shares insights about co-hosting the 'Normal World' podcast and comedy collaborations
Discussion of Dave's comedy tour experiences and performing across America with Stu
Talk about the challenges and rewards of being a working comedian in today's landscape
Joe and Dave explore themes of vulnerability and authenticity in comedy
recap:
Joe sits down with Dave Landau, a comedian known for his sharp wit and relatable storytelling, to discuss his career in comedy and his various projects. Dave has built a solid reputation in the comedy world with his special 'A Prison 10' and his memoir 'Party of One: A Fuzzy Memoir,' which gives fans a deeper look into his life and experiences.

The conversation covers Dave's work as a comedian and how he approaches his craft. They discuss the collaborative nature of his work on the 'Stu and Dave Do America' tour and podcast, where he partners with fellow comedian Stu to create content. Dave talks about the grind of being a touring comedian and what it takes to maintain momentum in an industry that's constantly changing.

Dave opens up about the personal aspects of comedy, discussing how he translates real life experiences into material that resonates with audiences. The memoir becomes a focal point for understanding Dave's perspective on life, relationships, and the comedy industry. Joe and Dave explore what it means to be authentic in comedy and how that vulnerability can be both a strength and a challenge.

Throughout the episode, there's a natural chemistry between the two, with Joe asking thoughtful questions about the creative process and Dave providing candid answers about his journey. They touch on the realities of performing, touring, and trying to build a sustainable career as a comedian in an era where the industry has shifted significantly.
